rows.grounds: feminine noun referring to a woman of the lowest class
future verb expressing the speaker's intent to explain
compound adverbial expression indicating accordance with reality; yathā+sthitam

items.question: In what manner will the nature of the outcaste woman be declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker intends to declare the outcaste woman.
The goddess is directly asked to listen.
The declaration will be made as it truly is.
items.inference: The true nature of the outcaste woman will be revealed to the goddess.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of antyajā in this context is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: I shall declare the outcaste woman; listen, O goddess, as she truly is.
